This gives investors an idea of how much the security has moved in the last year and whether it is trading near the top, middle or bottom of the range.

Relative Strength Index (RSI)
Apple Inc. (AAPL)’s Relative Strength Index (RSI) is 80.05. RSI is a technical indicator of price momentum, comparing the size of recent gains to the size of recent losses and establishes oversold and overbought positions. Average True Range (14) for Apple Inc. (AAPL) is stands at 3.30. ATR is a volatility indicator. Volatility measures the strength of the price action, and is often overlooked for clues on market direction.

Beta measures volatility or systematic risk, of a stock or a portfolio in comparison to the market as a whole. 1 shows stock moves with market. < 1 means less volatile than market. > 1 indicates more volatile than the market.
